description: Engine §10 permits a prefix parse on the span `($x.last-token)`.
grammar:
%const $S "ab"
%const $Q ("a" "b")
%const $TAG (A B)
%const $P #A
%const $E "a" ∖ "a"
%rule text $x:unit B %conditions (($x.last-token).parse(want …) ∨ ($x.last-token).parse(T …))
%rule unit A
%rule family unit
%rule want A
